Drop O 2s (s1) projector to remove the delocalized WF 10 (spread 5.36 Å², 45% of long-range hoppings); keep Sr 5s/5p/4d (9) + O 2p (3) = 12 WFs for valence
Parent has 52 bands; excluding 5 leaves 47 available for the outer window

diagnosis:
Three coupled failures stem from one root cause: the semicore exclusion (Sr 4s + Sr 4p, 4 bands) is not honoured by the gate because the excluded Sr 4p states overlap in energy with the kept O 2s states (bands 2-5 span -19.3 to -15.6 eV with negative gaps). The gate therefore scores the construction against all bands including the excluded semicore states, which the 13 WFs (designed for valence + O 2s) cannot represent — hence occupied_manifold_is_represented (49.9% missing) and band_distance_from_parent (6.4 eV). Separately, the O 2s-derived WF (WF 10, spread 5.36 Å²) carries 45% of the hopping weight beyond r_c = 10.03 Å, driving truncated_hopping_eta2 to 102.5 meV (limit 20 meV). The wannierisation also failed to converge (4000 iterations, oscillating deltas).

The fix: exclude all three semicore shells (Sr 4s, Sr 4p, O 2s = 5 bands) which creates an honoured cut with a 10.76 eV gap to the valence bands (band 6 at -4.9 eV). Drop O 2s from the PAO subset (removing the delocalized WF 10), reducing num_wann to 12 (Sr 5s/5p/4d = 9, O 2p = 3). Reduce num_bands to 47 (52 total - 5 excluded). This yields an honoured exclusion, eliminates the main long-range hopping source, and gives a well-matched 12-WF set for the 3 valence bands.
